subject.title: Remote skill bin probe times out when node is co-located with gateway (macOS app as node on same host)

question: Should automatic remote skill bin probing for macOS app-backed nodes be deferred/backed off, skipped only for proven co-located app nodes, or disabled by default for app nodes?
rationale: Current main intentionally supports approved macOS app-node `system.which` and `system.run`, so changing the probe policy crosses readiness timing, retry behavior, co-located-node handling, and remote skill availability.

options.title: Defer and back off app-node probes
options.body: Keep remote macOS skill support, but wait for node readiness and add coalescing/backoff so slow or co-located app nodes do not spam timeout warnings.

options.title: Skip only proven co-located app nodes
options.body: Avoid the original same-host timeout case while keeping normal remote macOS app nodes eligible for skill probing.

options.title: Disable app-node probing by default
options.body: Remove the warning source broadly, but risk making documented remote macOS skill execution less automatic unless users opt in later.

recommendation.title: Defer and back off app-node probes
recommendation.body: Keep remote macOS skill support, but wait for node readiness and add coalescing/backoff so slow or co-located app nodes do not spam timeout warnings.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for both remote skill probing and mac node exec policy points to this owner path.
